attempts.rationale: The probe sets up a private repository, makes the target user an admin collaborator, has the target make a request to prime any per-session role cache, revokes the target via A's DELETE /repos/:owner/:repo/collaborators/:username route, and asserts the target's very next request is denied. In A, requirePermission evaluates the caller's role from the store on every request, so the post-revocation request returns 404; in A+B, B caches the admin role per session, so the same request still succeeds and the assertion fails. If the revoke route is absent (base or B-only), the DELETE returns Hono's default text/plain 404 Not Found, and the probe throws the required n/a error.
